title: cheirinia nevadensis
intro: Cheirinia nevadensis, commonly known as Cheiranthus nevadensis or Nevada poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Cheirinia nevadensis include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
